learnerStatement: Simulated learner. This review finds problems; it is not evidence that anyone learned.
learnerBoundary: Everyday numeracy, simple charts, comparison of numbers and familiar household objects; no domain-specific theory assumed.

observations.action: Predicted nation bigger margin and locked

observations.outcome: 1000 sample margins±3.08 at1% and±2.19 at50%; band narrows
Population resets300million; margin±6.20 then±1.55, visible dot spread and band change
Corrects prediction using observed margins; number asked usually matters rather than share, exception substantial population fraction, assumes truly random picks

prediction.reason: Direct city/nation alternatives address share-of-population misconception.

interaction.reason: Population, sample size and half-population boundary visibly distinguish effects.

payoff.reason: Uses actual contrasts and finite-population/random-selection limits.

clarity.reason: Chart and margin labels clear; nation buttons explicitly signal population reset.

transfer.reason: Explains concrete large-population use and substantial-fraction condition for exception.

surprise.reason: Nation-bigger prediction reversed despite drastic share difference.

visualExplanation.reason: Dot spread and confidence band expose precision changes.

practicalValue.reason: Interpreting poll sample size and random-selection condition is central.

depth.reason: Sample size, population fraction exception and random-pick assumption linked.

complexity.reason: Compares sample count, population fraction and margin while holding dimensions fixed.
complexity.conceptualDemand: balanced: fractions and interval plots with supported statistical labels
complexity.interfaceBurden: low: discrete presets and labeled bands

whyCool: Shrinking the population from300million to100000 hardly changes the band, while asking4000 people halves the nation margin relative to1000.
caveat: Ideal random picks and50% truth simplify polling; no bias or nonresponse case is explored.
missingEvidence: Phone, keyboard-only, focus, contrast measurement, zoom/reflow and reduced motion untested
screenshots: Inline observed population2000 boundary and revealed nation4000 state; no saved image file
